sum_insured_options: Not specified in wording; refer Policy Schedule

room_rent.note: Room rent limit deferred to Policy Schedule / Product Benefit Table. Proportionate deduction applies if higher room taken.

icu.display: No cap (proportionate deduction not applicable for ICU)
icu.note: Policy wording explicitly states proportionate deductions are not applicable for ICU charges.

copayment.display: None (base); age 61+ co-pay per Product Benefit Table; 15% if non-PPN under PPN Discount option
copayment.note: Co-pay % for age 61+ at inception specified in Product Benefit Table. Additional 15% co-pay if PPN Discount optional cover chosen and treatment outside PPN.

sub_limits.note: Section C.I.(j) sub-limits for listed illnesses as per Policy Schedule/Product Benefit Table.

maternity.note: Maternity is a standard exclusion (Excl18). No maternity benefit mentioned for any plan variant.

cumulative_bonus.note: Accrues on claim-free renewal; reduced by 10% of SI on a claim year. Max cap 50% of SI.

restoration.note: Reload of Sum Insured available once per policy year for subsequent claims only; not for same illness/injury as prior claim; not for first claim of year.

pre_hosp.note: Number of days deferred to Policy Schedule / Product Benefit Table.

post_hosp.note: Number of days deferred to Policy Schedule / Product Benefit Table.

domiciliary.note: Asthma, bronchitis, diabetes, hypertension, epilepsy, arthritis, gout, nephritis, diarrhoea, psychiatric disorders, pyrexia of unknown origin excluded under domiciliary.

ayush.note: AYUSH in-patient hospitalization covered up to limits in Policy Schedule. AYUSH OPD also covered. Treatment must be within India.

ambulance.note: Road ambulance covered; limit in Policy Schedule. Air ambulance via Domestic/International Emergency Assistance (inbuilt).

modern_treatments.note: No explicit modern treatment cover clause. Some specific treatments excluded (RF ablation, cyber knife, femto laser, SMILE surgery).

consumables.note: Non-medical expenses in Annexure I excluded. Waived for Home Treatment and Nursing at Home optional benefit.

global_cover.note: Section D.II.50 excludes treatment outside India. International Emergency Assistance covers evacuation only.

notable_exclusions: Parkinson's disease, external congenital anomalies, STDs (non-HIV), stem cell therapy, dental (non-accident), treatment outside India, RF ablation/cyber knife/SMILE surgery
optional_riders: Room Upgrade, PPN Discount (15% co-pay outside PPN, 10% premium discount), Nursing at Home, Lifestyle Support Equipment, Portable Medical Equipment, Advance Health Check-up
insurer: Aditya Birla Health Insurance Co. Limited
variant_note: Sold in named plans (Standard, Classic, Premier). The policy wording defers every benefit limit to the Product Benefit Table, which is not part of this document, so the differences between the plans cannot be shown here. Confirm the plan limits against the policy schedule.
